name: Commands and processes
description: Run bounded commands and manage persistent non-interactive processes.

tools.name: command_run
tools.description: Run a non-interactive command in the OS sandbox and wait for completion. Network is disabled unless explicitly requested.

tools.name: process_start
tools.description: Start a persistent non-interactive process in the OS sandbox. Network is disabled unless explicitly requested.

tools.name: process_status
tools.description: Inspect a process started by AMK.

tools.name: process_output
tools.description: Read bounded output from a process started by AMK.

tools.name: process_stop
tools.description: Stop a process started by AMK.
